cand.title: Art Genève 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified organizer contacts: Charlotte Diwan, Director, and Audrey Dijkhuizen, Project manager. Diwan is the appropriate senior relationship/partnership entry point; Dijkhuizen is the operational entry point to identify accommodation coordination and exhibitor requirements. These relevance assessments are inferences from their published roles; neither person is verified as the hotel-contract signatory. Route requests through the published general fair contact info@artgeneve.ch, +41 22 761 11 11; these are not personal contact details.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 15th edition: public fair 28–31 January 2027 at Palexpo. The organizer also announced a VIP preview on Wednesday 27 January 2027. These are activity dates, not publication dates; public dates fall within the requested horizon. No officially announced 2028 edition dates were located in the reviewed sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional fit for a small subset, not the fair as a whole. Using the supplied 237-room Founex hotel profile and 20–120-room commercial band, the plausible targets are gallery/exhibitor teams, installation/project staff or organizer teams willing to use airport-corridor lodging, with optional briefings and small receptions. This is a sales hypothesis, not measured demand. The official hotel site supports Founex/A1/airport access, but its airport shuttle is morning/evening, first-come-first-served and not pre-bookable; it is not an event-specific Palexpo transfer. Dedicated fair-time transport would need agreement. This is neither a downtown luxury/VIP hotel substitute by default nor a resort-retreat event. The fair and its historical 1,700-plus-person gala exceed the supplied meeting capacities; do not pitch relocation of the main fair or gala.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo Geneva, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory classification: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, downtown Geneva or Lausanne. The exhibition venue is publicly confirmed and is not a competing hotel; this does not establish any lodging allocation.
findings.historicalRotation: Reviewed editions show a fixed Palexpo pattern rather than destination rotation: 25–28 January 2024, 30 January–2 February 2025, 29 January–1 February 2026, and announced 28–31 January 2027. Art Monte-Carlo is a separate fair launched in 2016, not a rotating Geneva edition. This supports recurrence, not an unpublished 2028 date or venue commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown contracting/booking pathway. The current official Partners page, headed “Global Lead Partner 2027,” includes “Partner hotels” and names/logos “manotel” and “president” (image labelled “logo hotel president”). Manotel is listed at group/brand level; no individual Manotel member properties are specified. These are partner listings, not verified 2027 room blocks or exclusive housing contracts. No edition-specific rates, allotments, booking code, official housing bureau, open hotel RFP or hotel booking portal was located. Separately, the 2026 closing release thanks “Manotel et l’InterContinental”; that is historical partnership evidence only, not 2027 committed inventory. Do not carry InterContinental forward as a confirmed 2027 partner.
findings.organizationStructure: Palexpo’s event listing explicitly identifies “Organizer: Palexpo SA.” Art Genève is the event brand/programme of this corporate exhibition organizer, not an evidenced membership association. Palexpo’s 2023 statement says it renewed the management team and that the events operate under its aegis. Palexpo is both the named organizer and venue operator; those roles should still be distinguished. No separate accommodation PCO, DMC or housing agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Existing official-site hotel relationships with Manotel and President are a competitive barrier, but public sources do not establish exclusivity, contracted room counts or sold-out inventory. InterContinental appears in 2026 partner thanks only. The 2026 gala was catered by Palexpo’s own culinary team, so it is not evidence of an available outside catering brief. No sourced overflow, displaced room demand or unmet accommodation requirement was found. Historical visitors must not be converted into overnight guests or peak rooms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Audrey Dijkhuizen via info@artgeneve.ch and request routing to the accommodation/partnership decision-maker; involve Charlotte Diwan for strategic fit. Ask who contracts lodging (organizer, galleries individually or an intermediary), which 2027 hotels have actual allocations, whether partner terms are exclusive, whether any teams still require rooms, and the dates including preview/setup/strike. Only if needs are confirmed, offer a modest team-block option within YOTEL’s supplied 20–120-room band, with a separately costed reliable Palexpo transfer plan and optional briefing/F&B. Do not promise inventory. If 2027 is closed, request the future hotel-partnership review timetable and permission to develop exhibitor relationships.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 dates and exhibition venue are confirmed; hotel sourcing is unconfirmed, not open. No buyer invitation, hotel RFP or available block is evidenced. The defensible near-term route is permission-based organizer outreach to establish whether any team/exhibitor accommodation remains addressable without conflicting with hotel partners. Do not label the candidate sales-ready on the prior “open_or_unannounced” seed alone.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the repeated Palexpo winter editions create a potential recurring relationship-development route for an airport-corridor hotel, even if 2027 allocation is unavailable. Seek the next hotel-partnership review and exhibitor accommodation briefing, not a venue-rotation bid. No 2028 dates, future hotel tender, review deadline or guaranteed demand is verified.
